Cristiano Ronaldo's World Cup Journey Ends; Other Tournament Highlights Noted

Cristiano Ronaldo's participation in the FIFA World Cup appears to have concluded following Portugal's elimination in the Round of 16 by Spain. The tournament also saw other notable matches, including Argentina's survival and Brazil's exit from the quarter-finals. Coverage also touched upon referee fitness and a disputed penalty call.
